name: minimal-listener-donate-checkout
changes: Every verified listener profile has a compact Donate button which expands to one amount input and a Donate checkout button.
Donations use existing Razorpay Checkout with server-side order validation, signature and captured-payment verification.
A verified one-time donation credits the selected listener wallet exactly once and appears in listener/admin wallet earnings.
Donations are separate from talk-time and monthly Exclusive subscriptions; listener payouts remain in the existing payout process.
Customer PWA assets bumped to 8.9.27 so the UI updates after deployment.
notes: Deploy frontend and backend together. The existing Render production start command runs the additive SQL schema migration automatically.
Razorpay must be configured and permitted to process listener tips/donations. No keys are included in the frontend.
Supported one-time donation amount: ₹10 to ₹10,000; no subscription and no use of the customer talk-time balance.
